title: Turkey, Worked Out.
note: Print palette. Derived from the site's globals.css (bone/near-black/flag-red identity) and adjusted for ink on paper — NOT lifted verbatim. The site's --accent #E4121F is the Turkish flag red at full saturation; on paper it vibrates against warm stock, so the BOOK's working accent is the site's own deep #A60A14 and the flag red is reserved for the single thesis line on the cover. Site --ink #15110D is opened to #1C1712 so 13.4px serif does not crush. Fonts differ from the site by design: the site runs Inter + Archivo + Spline Sans Mono; the book runs Anton + Gelasio + Space Mono. PAPER: the site's #F8F5EE is R248/G245/B238 — inside the near-white band, and a paid object on near-white stock reads as a printout. Warmed to #F5F0E4 for ink on paper, the same move Rome made; the screen value stays on the site.

fonts.display_note: single 400 weight only — never font-weight:bold, and it is ALL-CAPS by construction; set letter-spacing negative at cover size
